object.body:
Hello $data.ownerName,

You are now the account owner of the machine account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName.

You are responsible for managing this account and keeping it up to date. If you have questions, contact your administrator.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to notify a user that they have been assigned as the owner of a machine account.
object.name: New Machine Account Assigned
object.subject: You are now the owner of the machine account – $data.accountName
